title: Re-importing a customer keeps all its representatives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows Service Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Service Parts {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • A contacts import file contains {Customer-A} with its current details.
    For example: the file is ZZAUTOTEST-ssr-reimport.csv.
  • Starting screen: the contacts import is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the import finishes.
  • Step 2: Service Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Service Parts {Sales-rep-B} and Part Sales {Sales-rep-C} are all still there.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-N3, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N3: “Re-importing an existing customer through the contacts import never changes its representatives. Every field, including Service Parts and Part Sales, stays as it was. Before this change a re-import cleared the customer's representative.”
